problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: 70 tons
* Shipment Bravo: 64 tons
* Shipment Charlie: 30 tons
* Shipment Delta: 53 tons
* Shipment Echo: 51 tons
* Shipment Foxtrot: 66 tons
* Shipment Golf: 58 tons
* Shipment Hotel: 43 tons
* Shipment India: 59 tons
* Shipment Juliet: 56 tons
* Shipment Kilo: 66 tons
* Shipment Lima: 66 tons
* Shipment Mike: 50 tons
* Shipment November: 57 tons
* Shipment Oscar: 57 tons
* Shipment Papa: 60 tons
* Shipment Quebec: 42 tons
* Shipment Romeo: 40 tons
* Shipment Sierra: 60 tons
* Shipment Tango: 33 tons
* Shipment Uniform: 42 tons
* Shipment Victor: 32 tons
* Shipment Whiskey: 61 tons
* Shipment X-ray: 30 tons
* Shipment Yankee: 40 tons
* Shipment Zulu: 36 tons
* Shipment [1]: 40 tons
* Shipment [2]: 63 tons
* Shipment [3]: 43 tons
* Shipment [4]: 37 tons
* Shipment [5]: 37 tons
* Shipment [6]: 57 tons
* Shipment [7]: 42 tons
* Shipment [8]: 63 tons
* Shipment [9]: 31 tons
* Shipment [10]: 40 tons
* Shipment [11]: 54 tons

Each cargo plane can carry a maximum load of 100 tons. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Every shipment must be placed on exactly one plane, and the total weight on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
